skill.name: svg-logo-generator
skill.description: Generate simple geometric SVG logo assets with Python standard library scripts. The skill guides design analysis, SVG viewBox setup, palette selection, and file output for scalable logos.
skill.summary: Create geometric SVG logos from Python standard library templates.
skill.author: Dwsy

security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick and network findings are false positives caused by inline code formatting, code fences, and SVG namespace text. The Python scripts do write generated SVGs to hard-coded absolute paths, creating a bounded file-overwrite risk. No evidence found of prompt injection, dynamic code execution, or network exfiltration.

remediation.suggestion: Use a relative output path or an explicit user-supplied path inside the current workspace. Reject paths outside the workspace unless the user confirms them.

remediation.issue: Unconditional overwrite of generated logo files
remediation.suggestion: Check whether the output SVG already exists before writing. Ask for confirmation or generate a unique filename before replacing it.

remediation.issue: Documentation example omits output safety guidance
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to review the output path before running generated scripts and to keep outputs in the active project directory.

content.value_statement: Teams need quick logo drafts that stay scalable and easy to edit. This skill guides Python-based SVG generation with geometric shapes and palettes.
actual_capabilities: Defines scalable SVG canvases with viewBox and XML namespace guidance.
Uses Python standard library string assembly to create SVG files.
Creates logo variants with circles, rectangles, paths, polygons, gradients, and text.
Suggests color palettes with hex values for consistent branding.
Writes generated logo assets as SVG files for web or app use.
Includes example scripts for folder, tech line, circle, letter, and minimal folder logos.
limitations: It does not evaluate trademark conflicts or brand uniqueness.
Generated scripts may overwrite an output SVG if paths are not adjusted.
It does not optimize SVG accessibility metadata automatically.
It does not provide raster exports such as PNG without additional tooling.

use_cases.title: Startup identity draft
use_cases.description: A founder creates a simple geometric logo for a prototype before hiring a designer.

use_cases.title: Developer project icon
use_cases.description: A developer creates a scalable repository or app icon using editable SVG shapes.

use_cases.title: Design system placeholder
use_cases.description: A designer generates consistent placeholder marks while exploring color and shape directions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Logo
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a simple SVG logo for a notes app using two colors, geometric shapes, and a 512 by 512 viewBox.

prompt_templates.title: Customize a Palette
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three SVG logo concepts for a productivity tool. Use these colors: #0EA5E9, #FFFFFF, and #111827.

prompt_templates.title: Match a Visual Style
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a minimal technology logo with thin lines, rounded corners, and a folder metaphor. Save it as a scalable SVG.

prompt_templates.title: Refine for Production
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the generated SVG logo for scalability, path clarity, contrast, and easy editing. Then produce an improved version.

output_examples.input: Create a logo for a documentation portal.
output_examples.output: A 512 by 512 SVG concept with a folder shape, document lines, blue-green gradient, and accent symbol.

output_examples.input: Make a minimal project icon with the letters FS.
output: A square SVG mark with rounded corners.
Large F and S letterforms with contrasting colors.
A palette summary for primary, dark, and white colors.

output_examples.output: A line-based folder logo with a circular frame, connection details, and a single blue accent color.

best_practices: Choose a short visual metaphor before writing the SVG structure.
Use viewBox and relative geometry so the logo scales cleanly.
Set the output file path before running scripts to avoid unwanted overwrites.
anti_patterns: Do not assume generated logos are legally unique or trademark safe.
Do not run scripts without reviewing the output path first.
Do not mix many colors, gradients, and text styles in one small logo.

faq.question: Does this skill use external design libraries?
faq.answer: No. It prefers Python standard library code and direct SVG construction.

faq.question: Can it create multiple logo variants?
faq.answer: Yes. The included scripts show several folder, line, circle, and letter-based logo variants.

faq.question: Does it export PNG files?
faq.answer: No. It creates SVG output. Use a separate conversion tool for PNG exports.

faq.question: Can I edit the SVG later?
faq.answer: Yes. SVG is text-based, so designers and developers can adjust shapes, colors, and text.

faq.question: Will it choose brand colors for me?
faq.answer: It can suggest palettes with hex values. You can also provide exact brand colors.

faq.question: Is the generated logo trademark safe?
faq.answer: No. Review legal and brand clearance separately before using any generated logo commercially.
